mech.wasabi.title: Wasabi plate
mech.wasabi.text: It spoils when its timer runs out. Seat a diner of its colour before that happens.
mech.covered.title: Covered plate
mech.covered.text: Its colour hides once on the belt for one full loop. Memorise it in the kitchen window.
mech.vip.title: VIP guests
mech.vip.text: Gold guests only eat gold plates, and nobody else will touch them.
mech.lock.title: Chopstick lock
mech.lock.text: A locked diner cannot move until a diner of the shown colour has been served.
mech.frozen.title: Frozen dessert
mech.frozen.text: Tap a frozen diner three times to crack the ice before they can move.
mech.double.title: Double-decker
mech.double.text: A stacked plate fills two appetite points at once. Only a diner still needing two can take it.
fail.wasabiText1: A wasabi plate spoiled before anyone
fail.jamText1: Every seat is taken and nobody wants
fail.rescueSub: +1 seat · serve a diner · clear belt · +200 coins
fail.ad: Watch an ad for a free seat
fail.adOff: demo ads are off in the dev panel

win.streakHint: Win the next level for a streak bonus
ad.placeholder1: This stands in for a real ad network placement.

tutorial.seatAll: Seat everyone to clear the table
tutorial.blocked: Diners facing someone cannot move yet
tutorial.readKitchen: The window shows the next plates

dev.title: Dev panel
dev.seatsLine: Seats {seats} · belt cap {cap} · next visible {vis} · loop {loop}s
dev.stats: Stats logged: {n} · this week {w} cleared · streak {s} · {fps} fps
dev.hint1: Open this panel by tapping the level label five times.
dev.hint2: Per-level log fields: time, taps, fails, boosters, belt peak, result.
editor.title: Level editor
editor.unsolved: Tap Solve to measure the fail rate
editor.hint: Export writes JSON to the text box; paste it into levels/NNN.json. Import reads it back.
mech.chain.title: Chained seats
mech.chain.text: Two stools share one queue. The back stool only waits: its guest eats after the front guest leaves.
mech.rush.title: Rush hour
mech.rush.text: When the bell rings, plates come faster and the belt speeds up for fifteen seconds.
mech.special.title: Chef's special
mech.special.text: A bonus plate any guest may take. VIPs and ticket guests refuse it. The chef takes back what it replaces.
mech.picky.title: Ticket guest
mech.picky.text: Their plates are made to order and arrive in the printed sequence. Nobody else can take them.
mech.reserved.title: Reserved seat
mech.reserved.text: The marked stool only takes guests of its colour. Everyone else needs another seat.
mech.reverse.title: Belt reversal
mech.reverse.text: Every so often the belt runs backwards. Plates that reach the kitchen door go back inside for a while.
fail.reservedText1: The reserved stool takes one colour only,
fail.reservedText2: and everyone else ran out of seats.
fail.chainText1: The back stool only waits: its guest
fail.chainText2: eats after the front guest leaves.
fail.reverseText1: The belt ran backwards and took the plates
fail.pickyText1: Their plates come made to order, in sequence.
fail.pickyText2: Seat them just before their ticket is up.
toast.reservedSeat: That stool is reserved for {colour} guests
toast.reverseOff: The belt is back to normal
mode.dailyDesc: One board a day, the same for everyone.
mode.rushDesc: 90 s, endless guests. Score = plates served.
mode.zenDesc: No jams, no timers. Fewer coins.
mode.dailyBack: Come back tomorrow for a new board.
mode.zenNote: Zen pays fewer coins, and nothing can go wrong.
mode.noProgress: Modes keep their own stats and never move your level.
theme.stall.name: Street stall
theme.stall.desc: A wooden stand under a striped awning. Where every sushi chef starts.
theme.diner.name: Family diner
theme.diner.desc: Chrome, checker floors and red vinyl. The belt runs on milkshake power.
theme.rooftop.name: Rooftop bar
theme.rooftop.desc: Cocktails over the skyline. Dress sharp, the guests do.
theme.ryokan.name: Ryokan
theme.ryokan.desc: Shoji, tatami and a tea tray. Quiet, until the plates start moving.
theme.station.name: Space station
theme.station.desc: Nigiri in orbit. The belt is the only thing keeping the plates down.
decor.jukebox.name: Jukebox
decor.jukebox.desc: Chrome, coloured lights and three good songs.

decor.cactus.name: Space cactus
decor.robot.name: Serving arm
decor.robot.desc: It polishes plates when nobody is looking.
